p0_closure.evidence: The launcher is checked as an exact symlink with link text snps_shell and exact resolved path; m522_expect is applied only to the resolved regular snps_shell whose SHA matches 23a410...

The package is verified in staging, atomically moved, verified again at canonical, and only then marked complete. The EXIT trap selects canonical before staging and quarantines either path on any incomplete failure.

p1_findings.finding: The receipt records TIM-209/OPT-150 as zero and five clean constraint classes after exact shell checks, rather than parsing those reports again inside the receipt-construction Python block.
p1_findings.impact: Lineage is indirect but remains bound by the reviewed exact runner and sealed reports; it does not block the one-shot run.
p1_findings.next_fix: A future runner can parse the gate reports into the receipt instead of copying admitted constants.

p1_findings.finding: Member sealing excludes files by basename SHA256SUMS/SHA256SUMS.seal.sha256 at any depth, while topology exclusion uses root-relative names. A hypothetical nested file with either basename would be topologized but not hashed.
p1_findings.impact: The planned DC output population is not expected to create nested seal-named files, and exact topology would expose their presence; this is a latent generic-packager gap, not a current P0.
p1_findings.next_fix: Restrict seal exclusions to the two root-relative seal paths.

p2_findings.finding: ideal_clock_network.rpt is written immediately after a pinned set_ideal_network command rather than querying a reported attribute. Command failure remains fatal.
A second process could theoretically create the canonical directory between the final existence check and mv; the no-colliding-tool gate and quarantine logic make this operationally remote.

decision.authorization_scope: Standalone M514 logic-only 3 ns DC/STA solely to measure additive decoder-support logic area and timing cost.
decision.next_gate_after_run: Independent receipt-blind DC hammer of the sealed canonical output before admitting additive area/timing values.
